title: Lot's gho shopping
tagline: Lot's GHO shopping is a platform that users can shop multi-chain NFTs using GHO on mainnet, additionally the user will get a lottery ticket for each NFT they purchased, where the lottery prizes will be provided by the profit of us utilizing flashmint to do arbitrage.
description: It is a NFT marketplace that harnesses the power of the GHO token, offering users a seamless and cost-effective NFT minting experience directly on the mainnet. Our platform incorporates unique features such as permit and flashmint from GHO, enhancing accessibility and user experience for the entire GHO community and AAVE lenders!
how_its_made:
Key Features and Integrations:

Chainlink Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol:
Our smart contract is fortified with Chainlink, ensuring secure cross-chain token and data transfer. This integration sets a new standard for reliability and efficiency in cross-chain functionality.

ConnectKit-enabled Wallet Interaction:
Streamlining user interactions, we've seamlessly integrated Family ConnectKit and Wagmi to enhance wallet connection UX/UI, ensuring a smooth onboarding process for all users.

Flashmint Arbitrage Rewards and Gas Optimization:
Experience gas-free NFT minting on our platform via flashmint, eliminating fees and creating a decentralized, rewarding space with GHO token opportunities. Every mint triggers flashmint arbitrage, allowing users to earn GHO tokens, while GHO token holders can transfer without withdrawing Ethereum from Aave, enhancing liquidity in holders' financial portfolios.
